subject: Signal and System
questionText:
A real signal x(t) has Fourier transform X(f) which 
one of the following is correct? 
 
(a) Magnitude of X(f) has even symmetry 
 
 
while phase of X(f) has odd symmetry 
 
(b) Magnitude of X(f) has odd symmetry 
 
 
while phase of X(f) has odd symmetry 
 
(c) Both magnitude and phase of X(f) have even 
symmetry 
 
(d) Both magnitude and phase of X(f) have odd 
symmetry.

options.text: Both magnitude and phase of X
Both magnitude and phase of X

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-25 (Signal & System).
